# securitls_credential (Resource)

A SecuriTLS deployment credential. type is immutable; secret/key values are write-only and remain in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "securitls_credential" "secret" {
  name   = "secret example"
  type   = "secret"
  secret = "***"
}

resource "securitls_credential" "rsa" {
  name   = "rsa example"
  type   = "rsa"
  key = <<EOT
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
***
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) secret or rsa

### Optional

- `key` (String, Sensitive) Private key value when type=rsa.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret value when type=secret.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
